chartHintDaily: All lines are highlighted by default. Click a legend item to emphasize one line, and click it again to show all. Hover or press Tab to see daily figures.
chartHintHourly: All lines are highlighted by default. Click a legend item to emphasize one line, and click it again to show all. Hover or press Tab to see hourly figures.
statsNote: Period: {start} to {end}, trimmed to the actual range at both ends. Token counts are what providers report. History without a session, and calls such as connection tests, count as "Unattributed sessions". Cache hits: {cached} tokens (already included in input). Costs are estimated from each model's current prices and are only a guide: cache writes are charged at the input price, tiered pricing and free allowances aren't included, and deleted models or models without prices aren't counted. Messages are the stored user messages and final replies, including slash commands but not tool results or internal handoffs. Requests that didn't report usage aren't estimated.
noRate: Exchange rates unavailable; showing original currencies
loadingRate: Loading exchange rates; showing original currencies for now
